mapper.select: SELECT ACCOUNT_ID AS accountId, USER_ID AS userId, EXTERNAL_ACCOUNT_ID AS externalAccountId, INSTITUTION_NAME AS institutionName, ACCOUNT_NAME AS accountName, ACCOUNT_TYPE AS accountType, ACCOUNT_NUMBER_MASKED AS accountNumberMasked, BALANCE AS balance, IS_ACTIVE AS isActive, SYNCED_AT AS syncedAt FROM `ACCOUNT` WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND IS_ACTIVE = TRUE ORDER BY ACCOUNT_ID

SELECT ACCOUNT_ID AS accountId, USER_ID AS userId, EXTERNAL_ACCOUNT_ID AS externalAccountId, INSTITUTION_NAME AS institutionName, ACCOUNT_NAME AS accountName, ACCOUNT_TYPE AS accountType, ACCOUNT_NUMBER_MASKED AS accountNumberMasked, BALANCE AS balance, IS_ACTIVE AS isActive, SYNCED_AT AS syncedAt FROM `ACCOUNT` WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND EXTERNAL_ACCOUNT_ID = #{externalAccountId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `ACCOUNT` ( USER_ID, EXTERNAL_ACCOUNT_ID, INSTITUTION_NAME, ACCOUNT_NAME, ACCOUNT_TYPE, ACCOUNT_NUMBER_MASKED, BALANCE, IS_ACTIVE, SYNCED_AT ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{externalAccountId}, #{institutionName}, #{accountName}, #{accountType}, #{accountNumberMasked}, #{balance}, #{isActive}, #{syncedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE `ACCOUNT` SET IS_ACTIVE = FALSE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND IS_ACTIVE = TRUE
